text: Stop dividing people into “your own” and others. The desire to surround yourself with “your own” is a subtle form of separation from the world. Practice seeing “your own” in every person you meet - in the irritating neighbor, in the slow cashier, in the corrupt politician you despise. Each of them is you, living another line of life. As in a pinball machine, different events at different moments in time led to the fact that with some people you feel yourself to be very different. Although, in essence, you are absolutely identical steel balls... Do not turn away from such people, and even more so do not demonize them. On the contrary, it is precisely “strangers” who expand the Universe for you; they also reveal to you what you no longer notice in yourself. Act this way until everyone becomes “your own” for you, and the concept of “stranger” disappears.
